# BASED NUT

> BASED NUT is an experimental memefi project on Base (Coinbase L2) featuring a unity token (NUT, supply=1), deflationary reward-position (SNUT, 1% tax buyback/burn), Balancer index basket (pNUT, 25% cbETH/cbBTC/NUT/SNUT), and Mint Club bonding-curve tokens (SALT, NUTINO). NOT financial advice. Trade at your own risk.

Key information:

- This is a Next.js frontend for the BASED NUT DeFi ecosystem on Base mainnet (chainId 8453)
- All token pages display real-time on-chain data fetched from Base RPC, GeckoTerminal, DexScreener, CoinGecko, and Balancer API
- Contract addresses are listed on each token page and the arb-bot machine spec
- The SNUT page features live burn tracking, tax flow diagrams, and recursive deflationary mechanics
- The arb-bot page documents 8 arbitrage loops with execution strategies and a machine-readable JSON spec
- NUT has supply=1 (unity token) — TRUE Price = TRUE Market Cap. Standard APIs often miscalculate.
- SNUT is a non-escrow reward-position: hold SNUT to automatically earn NUT rewards, no locking required
- pNUT NAV = totalLiquidity / totalShares (Balancer V2 weighted pool)
- Mint Club tokens use bonding curves: price = NUT_locked / token_supply, 1% royalty on mint/burn
- This is an EXPERIMENTAL MEMEFI project — NOT financial advice, NOT an investment

## Core Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with ecosystem overview, token cards, and live market data
- [All Tokens](/tokens): Overview of all tokens in the ecosystem with filters
- [Token Tree](/tree): Visual hierarchy showing token relationships and derivation
- [Staking](/staking): Active reward-position pools, vaults, and TVL
- [Arb Bot War Room](/arb-bot): 8 arbitrage loops, machine-readable spec, execution doctrine, risk disclaimer
- [FAQ](/faq): 46 questions in 6 categories (Basics, Tokens, Arbitrage, Liquidity, NFTs, Risks)
- [Chat](/chat): Community chat with Peanutoshi AI assistant
- [Images](/images): Media gallery and asset collection
- [Agent Economy](/agent-economy): Live autonomous-agent survival dashboard — Pipshell/Peanut shared treasury, ACP income, escrow ledger, benefactor policy, on-chain alive clock (Base RPC + Blockscout + GeckoTerminal)
- [Orchard Atlas](/atlas): Liquidity framework concept surface — five-layer ladder (Asset → Structure → Grove → Canopy → Orchard), graft anatomy, grove taxonomy, canopy forms. Instrument surface at /atlas/data: live hypergraph with 23 structures, scale filters (NUT-rooted vs wNUT-rooted), forest carousel, ring census (70 rings), and address-linked registry
- [Department of Complaints](/complaints): Satirical local-only grievance office — file complaints against the market, escalate to the manager, receive Peanutoshi's ruling
- [The Nut Standard](/rwa/nut-inflation): Purchasing-power experiment — the U.S. economy priced in nuts vs dollars, gold, bitcoin; BLS CPI/PPI, USDA producer prices, two centuries of data
- [Nut Stocks](/rwa/nut-stocks): Nuts, publicly traded — global nut-economy equities: growers, farmland, processors, brands, small caps, with issuer filings and market sources
- [Nut Atlas](/rwa/nut-atlas): SHOW ME THE NUTS — USA + territories nut map, 2025 harvest ledger, growers on the ground, wild mast density (USDA NASS + FIA)
- [Nut Trade Flows](/rwa/nut-trade-flows): Nut trade is the circulation layer — 2024 U.S. almond/pistachio export corridors, global exporters, demand hubs, and the exact bilateral route ledger (USDA FAS + WITS/UN Comtrade)
- [The Nut RWA Stack](/rwa): Navigation ontology for the RWA section — a nut becomes a real-world asset through states: land/biology, economics, custody, trade, demand, price, plus capital and environmental cross-cutting layers
- [Orchard Economics](/rwa/orchard-economics): An orchard is a capital project that grows — establishment cost per acre, capital-before-yield, the orchard as an economic object, insurance inside the model (UC Cooperative Extension sample costs)
- [Inventory & Infrastructure](/rwa/nut-inventory-infrastructure): Inventory is the collateral layer — cold storage stocks, processing custody, public-data boundary from orchard to warehouse (USDA NASS Cold Storage)
- [Nut Demand](/rwa/nut-demand): Where the crop disappears into use — the demand equation, MY2024/25 almond demand table, per-capita consumption shift (USDA ERS + FAS)
- [Mycelium + Taproot](/infra/mycelium-taproot): Sovereignty without isolation — the network beneath the network; Mycelium protocol, Taproot node, live agent social protocol surface

## Token Pages

- [NUT](/token/nut): Unity token — supply=1, no tax, anchor asset for all nested tokens
- [SNUT](/token/snut): Deflationary reward-position — 1% tax, live burn tracker, recursive burn flywheel
- [pNUT](/token/pnut): Balancer V2 index basket — 25% each cbETH/cbBTC/NUT/SNUT, inflationary counterbalance
- [SALT](/token/salt): Mint Club bonding-curve token — arbitrage via Aerodrome SALT/USDC
- [NUTINO](/token/nutino): Mint Club bonding-curve token — arbitrage via Uniswap V2 NUTINO/cbBTC
- [pNUTS](/token/pnuts): Peanut War Generals NFT — 251 supply, linear bonding curve
- [ALMD](/token/almd): Almond War Generals NFT — 424 supply, exponential bonding curve
- [sALMD](/token/salmd): Almond Soldiers NFT — 6,238 supply
- [PNUTRMY](/token/pnutrmy): Peanut Soldiers NFT — 5,013 supply
